newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices stronger on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices stronger on good demand.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices rose on Tuesday for the third straight session this year, pushed up by strong demand at the weekly coffee auction in Nairobi, officials said.
"Now we're getting some good crop, there is some good general all-round demand," a trader said. "Most of it from Europe."
Grade Cs averaged $197 per 50-kg bags from $192 last week, while Grade ABs averaged $206 from $199.
The coffee board said it sold all 25,817 60-kg bags it offered for sale compared to 21,765 bags sold last week. Some 30,000 to 35,000 bags are scheduled for sale in February.
